components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action colour: the next thing to press.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; background: #ea3; color: #222; border: 4px solid #111; border-radius: 0; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #333; font: 16px/24px Topaz, 'Courier New', monospace; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #fc6; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translate(4px, 4px); box-shadow: none; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #222; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Button
components.css: .ds-btn { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; background: #eec; color: #222; border: 4px solid #111; border-radius: 0; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #333; font: 16px/24px Topaz, 'Courier New', monospace; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn:hover { background: #ccd; } .ds-btn:active { transform: translate(4px, 4px); box-shadow: none; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #222; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.description: One ticket on the board: number, title, stage.

narrative.overview: The page is a field with signboards standing on it, drawn as a 16-bit game would draw them. The pipeline is four stations in a row, read left to right: in line, building, review, shipped. The first screen is the whole status: four stations side by side, six doors beneath them, and the work order monitor on the right. Form follows Super Mario Bros. 3; colour follows The Chaos Engine, in 32 twelve-bit Amiga colours.
keyCharacteristics: A mossy field with bone-faced signs: muted, metallic, never candy-bright.
Four stations in pipeline order. Position in the row is the status.
Square corners everywhere. Radius is zero.
4px near-black outlines on anything that is an object in the world.
Hard offset shadows with no blur.
One typeface, Topaz, at two sizes.

rules.name: The Flat Fill Rule
rules.body: Every fill is one solid colour. Gradients are prohibited, including on backgrounds and inside sprites.

rules.name: The One Outline Rule
rules.body: Outlines are Outline and text is Ink. Nothing is outlined in a colour.

rules.name: The Position Rule
rules.body: Which station a ticket stands at says what state it is in. Colour never carries status by itself.

rules.name: The Two Sizes Rule
rules.body: Text is 16px or 32px, whole multiples of the face's native 8px grid. No other sizes, no clamp(), no letter-spacing, no bold and no italics.

rules.name: The No Blur Rule
rules.body: Every shadow has a blur radius of zero. If a shadow is soft, it is wrong.

dos: Do draw every new sprite and scene at the Super Mario Bros. 3 level of detail: flat fills, a dark outline, at most one highlight and one shade.
Do keep corners square and shadows hard (blur 0).
Do keep sizes and positions on the 8px grid, and show sprites at whole multiples of their native size.
Do make each object stand for something real in the pipeline.
Do say in the header whether the data is sample or real.
Do keep the Tehdas ASCII logo and its credit in the footer.
donts: Don't add gamified productivity: no points, streaks, badges, leaderboards or confetti that score people or their work.
Don't drift toward the dark navy SaaS dashboard with stat tiles and cyan accents.
Don't let demoscene styling, other than the typeface, spread beyond the footer.
Don't add detail beyond the SMB3 level: gradients, soft shadows, smooth shading or high-resolution illustration mixed into pixel scenes.
Don't use border-radius, filter: blur, backdrop-filter, gradient text or a coloured stripe down one side of a box.
Don't invent progress: no fake commands, random verdicts or motion that implies work is happening.
Don't set text at any size other than 16px and 32px.
Don't let copy cheer. No exclamation marks.
